# One Set of Principles, Many Governments

<!-- STEP id="team-d-verdict" -->
## Elections Are Not Enough

Team D falls short of a democracy, even though it holds elections. Its students cannot freely choose among candidates, one person holds most of the power, and other voices are weak.

**An election alone does not make a democracy.**

<!-- STEP id="one-principle-many-models" -->
## No Single Model

Democracies share principles such as freedom, equality, participation, rule of law, rights and duties. But democracy does not offer a single model of government.

Tap each of the five countries, and see how differently each one works.
